title: What each rolling tier of the Tier-0-only rolling polls through verifyBundle reports about its electorate
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-rolling-report-vectors.py: each poll rebuilt by its own generator's build (verifier-ballots-v5-tier0-sealed-vectors.py, verifier-ballots-v5-tier0-live-vectors.py), its counts by rolling-report-vectors.py's report under the bundle's anchoring clock, independently of packages/crypto and packages/verifier.
description: For each vector file, its report's `tiers` electorate counts, as strings: every ballot on its board names its step with a membership proof that verifies, so every one counts toward the smallest step used.
